name: Krannert Building
scope: Krannert-only source-backed facade cadence refinement. No master/shared files, placement marker, manifest, README, or other building assets were edited.
independent_round9_response: The reviewer found R9 improved the broad-pier/narrow-glazing expression but the visible long wings still read as squat per-floor windows. R11 changes the documented south/front 10-bay elevation and one photographed long wing to narrow continuous upper-storey glazing strips with fine horizontal floor-level transoms.

primary_source.provider: Indiana Architect / Indiana Society of Architects
primary_source.title: Indiana Architect, October 1965, selected-for-exhibition project page
visible_cues: tall, narrow vertical glazing extending across the upper facade
primary_source.limits: A perspective 1965 image, not a dimensioned elevation or a direct record of current condition.

visible_cues: long facade with repeated tall slim glazed slots
secondary_source.limits: Capture date, camera calibration, and dimensions are not supplied.

model_changes: Kept the R9 broad-pier treatment and narrow openings across short and re-entrant elevations.

On the 10-bay south/front elevation and one photo-visible long wing, changed individual upper-floor glazing rectangles to one narrow vertical glazing strip spanning modeled upper levels, interrupted visually only by fine transoms at modeled floor datums.
Estimated strip width is 0.82 m and pier width is 0.72 m, chosen as visual proportions from perspective photographs; neither is a surveyed measurement.
No roof, penthouse, floor elevation, footprint, placement, ground story, entrance canopy, or courtyard/seam geometry was changed.

renders.render_setup: Generated after reopening the saved source blend in Blender 5.2.3. Temporary cameras, lighting/world settings, and render-only ground were not saved to the building asset.

sources_reviewed.title: Purdue Krannert Building Emergency Maps
sources_reviewed.limit: Hand-drawn diagrams without scale, dimensions, issue date, or as-built status; adjacency/topology only.

sources_reviewed.title: Krannert Building MEL Renovation Phase III, Second Floor Furniture Plan
sources_reviewed.limit: Sheet explicitly marked NOT TO SCALE; renovation furniture plan is not an as-built measured interior plan.

sources_reviewed.title: Purdue Daniels School of Business self-guided tour
sources_reviewed.limit: Interior photographs support room appearance and furnishing types but lack reliable plan position/dimensions.

interior_and_courtyard_registration.decision: No dimensionally registered room partitions, circulation routes, courtyard walls, or re-entrant seam edits were justified by the available sources. Existing Drawing Room and Parrish Library spaces remain. Whole-floor interior organization and the courtyard gap remain explicitly unverified.
interior_and_courtyard_registration.evidence_needed: A dimensioned/as-built drawing with known scale and orientation, or interior photos tied to specific floor/position, is needed to place partitions or resolve the courtyard seam defensibly.

independent_grade_status: Awaiting fresh independent full-building review; no self-score assigned.
